# Commander Farragut

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P0](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0000)</sub>

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

A good seaman worthy of his command, the captain is characterized by a wide-awake nature and a resolute determination. He is driven by a singular motivation to rid the seas of a specific monster, viewing the pursuit as a fatal contest between himself and the creature.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P26](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P0](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0000)_

## History

Commander Farragut was appointed to lead the [United States](../codex/places.md#united-states) expedition aboard the frigate [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) to hunt a mysterious sea monster reported in the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic). After months of fruitless searching in the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) led to rising tensions and near-mutiny among the crew, he set a final three-day deadline to locate the creature before abandoning the mission. On the final night of this ultimatum, the target was successfully spotted by the harpooner [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P9](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P11](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P21](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P3](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P7](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P9](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0009), +55 more_
